# Getting help

Jx Suite is maintained by Avunu LLC.

- **How do I…?** Start with the [documentation](https://jxsuite.com/docs). If it does not answer you, open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/jxsuite/jx/issues) and say what you were trying to do.
- **Something is broken.** Open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/jxsuite/jx/issues) with the version (Help › About in Jx Studio, or `jx --version`), what you did, what you expected and what happened instead.
- **Your account or subscription on the hosted studio** (studio.jxsuite.com): email [support@jxsuite.com](mailto:support@jxsuite.com) from any address, and include your GitHub login. You can manage or cancel a subscription yourself from Preferences › Accounts in the studio.
- **A security problem:** follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not open a public issue.
- **Your personal data:** email [privacy@jxsuite.com](mailto:privacy@jxsuite.com). The [privacy policy](https://jxsuite.com/privacy) explains your rights.

The full list, with Avunu LLC's postal address, is at [jxsuite.com/support](https://jxsuite.com/support).
